title: decree plugin frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of a plugin, .decree/plugins/<name>.md: one machine's folder, .decree/machines/<name>/, shared as one file: its machine, its scripts, its cron files, and seeds for its state/ and order/. The markdown body below the frontmatter tells a person what the plugin is for; decree keeps it as written. `decree install` installs it: machine.yml, scripts/ and cron/ are the installed copy, which an install moves to .decree/archive/ before it writes over an edit in place; state/ and order/ are the project's, seeded once and never overwritten. A plugin may extend another (`extends`), holding only what it adds or replaces; an official plugin (`decree_*`) is never edited (P3). `decree check` checks the rest: that every `needs` and `extends` is in plugins/ (P2), the installed machine itself (V1-V21), and the cron files as messages (M3). Reference: docs/reference/plugins.md.

name.description: The plugin's name: equal to the file's stem, plugins/<name>.md, and the name of the folder it installs, .decree/machines/<name>/ (P1). A name starting with `decree_` is an official plugin's, reserved for the plugins decree ships (P1); a plugin that extends another never takes its base's name.

extends.description: The plugin this one is installed on top of, in plugins/ (P2): official, from a URL, or the project's own, but not a library (a plugin with no machine), and with no loop (P1). The base is installed in full under its own name; this one installs the base's machine and files, then its own path by path: a file replaces the base's at that path or adds one, `machine` replaces the base's whole, `null` removes the base's file, and `needs` adds to the base's. While installed, it carries the base's cron files, which the base is installed without.

source.description: The https URL the plugin is published at: `decree install --update` fetches it, shows the diff and asks before writing it. No other value; an official plugin has none (P1).

oneOf.description: `{<need>: <plugin>}`: the need met by another plugin, which install names in the machine in its place (a `machine:` invoke, a `router:`, an `emits` list) and scripts get as DECREE_NEED_<NEED>.

needs.description: The other plugins this one relies on: each machine it invokes (`machine`), routes through (`router`, or the machine `decree_router` a `model` state with no `router` uses) or emits to, and each library it sources. Each entry is a plugin name, or a one-key map `{<need>: <plugin>}` naming the plugin that meets it. The plugin meeting each must be in plugins/ (P2); `decree install` refuses a plugin whose needs are missing. Every script gets DECREE_NEED_<NEED>, the plugin that meets it.

machine.description: The machine, as .decree/machines/<name>/machine.yml holds it, without `name`: the plugin's `name` names it. Installed with `name` first; machine.schema.json describes the rest. Optional: a plugin of scripts only is a library other plugins name in `needs` and source from .decree/machines/<name>/scripts/.

scripts.description: Every file of .decree/machines/<name>/scripts/, by its path there, to its text. A path is plain and relative: no `..`, `.`, empty parts or leading `/` (P1). An installed file is executable when its text starts with `#!`, and otherwise not. A file in scripts/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed. In a plugin that extends another, `null` removes the base's file at that path.

cron.description: Every cron file of .decree/machines/<name>/cron/, by its file name there (`<file>.md`), to its text: a cron file as messages.md describes it, with `cron:`, and `machine:` unless it runs this machine. Part of the installed copy, like scripts: a file in cron/ the plugin does not ship is removed when it is installed, an edit in place counts as an edit, and the folder goes with the plugin. In a plugin that extends another, `null` removes the base's file at that path.

state.description: Seeds for .decree/machines/<name>/state/ ($DECREE_STATE_DIR), by path there, to its text. Each file is written only when absent and is never overwritten or removed: the state is the project's data. A file named `*.git.*` (`order.git.txt`) is committed; any other is not. state/ holds data, never code: nothing in it is run or sourced. In a plugin that extends another, `null` removes the base's file at that path.

order.description: Seeds for .decree/machines/<name>/order/, by file name there (`<file>.md`), to their text: messages the official `order` plugin runs in order at daemon start. Each is written only when absent and is never overwritten or removed: order/ is the project's, and committed. In a plugin that extends another, `null` removes the base's file at that path.

^x-.description: An extension, for a tool built on decree (existential's `x-exist-services`, say): decree reads none, and keeps them on export, as Compose and OpenAPI keep `x-` keys.
